Posterior predictive check on the correlation-matrix RMSE

Source: R/plots.R
plot_ppc.Rd

Histogram of the replicated correlation-matrix RMSE stored on the fit (fit$ppc$rmse.r): for each posterior draw, the RMSE between the between-participant correlation matrix under the replicated data and under the observed data. Lower is better; the median and central credible-interval bounds are marked.

Usage

plot_ppc(fit, breaks = 30, ...)

Arguments

fit

A bayesqm_fit.

breaks

Passed to hist().

...

Passed to hist().

Value

The input, invisibly.
